data.one_liner: File-based key-value store with automatic cache expiration in temporary folders.
data.what_it_does: ffcache is a file-based key-value store that saves data in the app's temporary folder and on the web via idb_shim. It automatically expires cached data after a set duration and cleans up old entries upon initialization.
use_when: You need to store temporary key-value data with expiration times.
You want to cache strings, bytes, or JSON data locally.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose permanent key-value store, as the OS can delete temporary files at any time.
strengths: Supports automatic cache expiration and timeouts.
Supports strings, bytes, and JSON data.
Cross-platform support including iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web.
weaknesses: Data can be deleted by the OS at any time because it resides in the temporary folder.
Not suitable for general-purpose key-value storage.
data.setup_notes: For web platform usage, calling cache.init() is required.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a persistent, general-purpose key-value store that is not cleared by the OS unexpectedly.

alternatives.name: flutter_cache_manager
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are specifically caching web files and media with advanced download management.
